items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Snooky was in there, yeah, out of Dayton, Ohio. ... Snooky was a good man. He was a good trumpet player.

ctx.x: Well now, there was just one other person, before we leave, Lionel -- did Snooky Young come up then when you were there?
Snooky was in there, yeah, out of Dayton, Ohio.
Well now -- oh, no, he had been in Lunceford's band.
